name: Chou
source:
After waking up, I surveyed my surroundings.
I don't recognize this place... but deep inside, I know it.
This train is running right along its tracks.
I'm on it... but why?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/22211]Freem![/url]]
translation:
醒来后，我环顾四周。
这里很陌生……内心深处，却又觉得熟悉。
这列火车正沿着轨道行驶。
我就在车上……可为什么会在这里？

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/22211]Freem![/url]]
